name: Miscommunication
caption: Liam Ray and Chiang Lee Chan, who outlasted three teams in the Tag Team Turmoil Gauntlet at Unwanted before Derecho and Blazer eliminated them.

name: Morally Correct
caption: Brandon Ramos and Seth Miller, who entered the Tag Team Turmoil Gauntlet at Unwanted and were eliminated by Chiang Lee Chan's 450 splash.

name: The Mafia

caption: The Don's stable of January 2002 with Skylar Thomas, Chris Titan and Mike Extreme, which interfered in the Don's World Championship defence against Brandon Blade on the 20 January 2002 iNtense 39.

members.name: The Don
members.note: 'The Don's Mafia' is how the 20 January 2002 page names it.

members.note: Named with Skylar Thomas and Chris Titan on the 20 January 2002 iNtense 39.

identity.note: Shares a bare name with the-mafia-bwf, the-mafia-cwa-association-2003; no receipt in the jOlt record connects this team to any of them. Filed distinct per the no-auto-merge collision doctrine, open to a merge on evidence.

name: Total Conquest
caption: Sepiroth Du Luc and Persephone, the first jOlt World Tag Team Champions, who won the belts at iNtense 22 and lost them at Thieves Honour.

name: Fueled by V.I.A.G.R.A.
caption: Chris Titan, Chris Register, High Flyer and Tony Davis, who took the jOlt World Tag Team Championship from Total Conquest at Thieves Honour and lost it to VIAGRA at Rise of the Legends.

name: Unknown Elements

tenures.note: Shawn Arrows and Carlos Lopez, 15 March 2005.

caption: Shawn Arrows and Carlos Lopez, who won the opener of the first Tuesday Night Intense and accepted Impact Rowdy Burns's challenge for The Retort on 15 March 2005.

name: Fueled by Ignorance

tenures.source: The fed's own board reviews, which bill the members as the team (first /promotions/jolt-2001/archive/intense-35-review-2012-06-21.html).

caption: Chris Titan and Chris Register, the former Tag Team Champions, who lost to the Heirs of Wrestling on iNtense 35 and fell apart when Titan attacked Register.

name: Heirs of Wrestling

tenures.source: The fed's own board reviews, which bill the members as the team (first /promotions/jolt-2001/archive/intense-35-review-2012-06-21.html).

caption: An arrogant tag team of three big men with a mouthpiece that beat Fueled by Ignorance and the RingRats and won the tag titles in the four-corners match at Divide & Conquer.

tenures.source: The fed's own board reviews, which bill the members as the team (first /promotions/jolt-2001/archive/warriors-01-review-2012-06-24.html).

caption: Identical twins who back The Nashvillain and G.G. Gentry; they attacked Aria Murphy and Jonathan Conspiracy and fought Wippit Guud at Warriors 04.

name: RingRats

tenures.source: The fed's own board reviews, which bill the members as the team (first /promotions/jolt-2001/archive/intense-36-review-2012-06-27.html).

name: Clan Avispa

tenures.source: The fed's own board reviews, which bill the members as the team (first /promotions/jolt-2001/archive/divide-conquer-review-2012-07-30.html).

caption: A luchador clan, billed Clan Avispa and Avispa Clan, that beat Fueled by Ignorance on Warriors 02 and was in the four-corners tag match at Divide & Conquer.

name: Sweet Sweet Lovin'

tenures.source: The fed's own board reviews, which bill the team (first /promotions/jolt-2001/archive/intense-37-review-2012-07-03.html; the iNtense 39 review names its two members).
